findings: The optional current_artist/path-SHA pair defaults to None/None. API and CLI reject incomplete pairs before generation; CLI rejects the pair outside --build-current.

No override retains the prior actual historical E8 file check. An override requires the same resolved artist path as the sealed n16 audit and pins its explicitly supplied current SHA into the new ledger.

Historical artist metadata is detached from the pinned completed audit and retained as sealed ancestry; the validation-copy config, original seed C3A, sealed reports and artist operation behavior are not changed.

freeze_context requires the actual hardpinned frozen11 receipt and the same frozen10 origin/context manifest/four overrides. Every one of the twelve buffered tools must match its actual frozen11 SHA and byte count.

Exclusive tools_headful_12 writes carry the same twelve raw helper payloads; new builder/owner/peer pins and origin_context_headful_tools_receipt describe the successor without replaying the historical frozen11 temporal Source ledger.

build_current admits only the new frozen12 producer-bound receipt and rehashes its current ledger, all twelve tools and the same frozen11 predecessor tools; old canonical builder387 is not treated as a current executable input.

Keep-open behavior, historical/runtime/current catalog bridge, grants, profile paths, no-input-in-evidence checks, final ledger rehash and exclusive writes remain protected by the unchanged branches/guards.
limitations: Bounded Source delta and actual frozen11 receipt metadata review only; no predecessor temporal input ledger replay or new artifact generation.
Current artist bytes/SHA are not verified by this reviewer. They must be supplied and independently protected at generation/launch; no artist operations occurred.
Source readiness does not infer a native/UI acceptance result or a fresh launch grant.
